temperature_range: 250 °C for TiO2 and Ir deposition, 150 °C for Al2O3 deposition
summary: The study describes the preparation of Ir/TiO2/cellulose and Ir/Al2O3/cellulose composites using atomic layer deposition (ALD) for catalytic applications. The composites were synthesized by depositing TiO2, Al2O3, and Ir on cellulose fibers through ALD, resulting in high-quality, conformal thin films with uniform thickness. The composites showed enhanced photocatalytic activity compared to pure TiO2/cellulose, with Ir demonstrating higher efficiency than Ag in improving charge separation.
evidence: In this paper, we report the preparation of Ir/TiO2/cellulose and Ir/Al2O3/cellulose composites for catalytic applications by the ALD of TiO2, Al2O3, and Ir on cellulose fibers. TiO2 was deposited from Ti(OMe)4 and H2O at 250 °C, Al2O3 from Al(CH3)3 and H2O at 150 °C, and Ir from Ir(acac)3 (acac = acetylacetonato) and O2 at 250 °C. The Ir/TiO2/cellulose composite showed enhanced photocatalytic activity as compared to the TiO2/cellulose composite.
